js: (()=>{const el=document.querySelector('#composer-input'); if(!el) return 'no-input'; const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(el,'帮我开始一个新的研究方向：量子计算实验与论文投稿计划'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); return 'typed';})()

(()=>{const b=document.querySelector('button.send-btn'); if(!b) return 'no-send'; const st={mode:b.dataset.mode,disabled:b.disabled,ready:b.dataset.ready}; if(!b.disabled) b.click(); return JSON.stringify(st);})()

(async()=>{const t0=Date.now(); while(Date.now()-t0<45000){const m=document.querySelector('[data-test="topic-approval-content"]'); if(m){const d=document.querySelector('[role="dialog"]'); const inp=document.querySelector('[data-test="topic-name-input"]'); return JSON.stringify({found:true,dialogText:(d?d.innerText:'').slice(0,1400),inputValue:inp?inp.value:null,hasOriginalQuestion:(d?d.innerText:'').includes('帮我开始一个新的研究方向')});} await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return JSON.stringify({found:false,body:document.body.innerText.slice(-1000)});})()

(()=>{const c=document.querySelector('[data-test="topic-approval-content"]'); const d=document.querySelector('[role="dialog"]'); const r=(c||d||document.body).getBoundingClientRect(); const approve=document.querySelector('[data-test="topic-approve"]'); const stay=document.querySelector('[data-test="topic-stay"]'); const close=document.querySelector('[data-test="topic-approval-close"]'); const radius=(el)=>el?getComputedStyle(el).borderRadius:null; return JSON.stringify({winW:innerWidth,docScrollW:document.documentElement.scrollWidth,dialog:{left:Math.round(r.left),right:Math.round(r.right),width:Math.round(r.width)},radius:{approve:radius(approve),stay:radius(stay),close:radius(close)},buttons:{approve:!!approve,stay:!!stay,close:!!close}});})()

(()=>{const inp=document.querySelector('[data-test="topic-name-input"]'); if(inp){const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(inp,'量子计算实验（用户改名后的长名称 · 窄窗换行验证）'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));} const ta=document.querySelector('#composer-input'); const setT=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set; setT.call(ta,'等待期间写下的草稿，确认后应跟随到新话题且不自动发送。'); ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); return 'edited';})()
(()=>{const b=document.querySelector('[data-test="topic-approve"]'); if(!b) return 'no-approve'; if(b.disabled) return 'approve-disabled'; b.click(); return 'approved-clicked';})()

(async()=>{const t0=Date.now(); while(Date.now()-t0<60000){const modal=document.querySelector('[data-test="topic-approval-content"]'); const body=document.body.innerText; const answered=body.includes('已按你的选择处理'); if(!modal&&answered){const ta=document.querySelector('#composer-input'); const send=document.querySelector('button.send-btn'); let ctx=null; try{ctx=await (await fetch('/api/session/context')).json();}catch(e){} let topics=null; try{topics=await (await fetch('/api/graph/topics')).json();}catch(e){} return JSON.stringify({modalGone:true,answeredShown:true,draft:ta?ta.value:null,sendDisabled:send?send.disabled:null,sendMode:send?send.dataset.mode:null,context:ctx?{topic_id:ctx.topic_id,topic_name:ctx.topic_name,messages:(ctx.messages||[]).length}:null,topics:topics?topics.topics.map(t=>({id:t.topic_id,title:t.title})):null});} await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));} return JSON.stringify({modalGone:!document.querySelector('[data-test="topic-approval-content"]'),answeredShown:document.body.innerText.includes('已按你的选择处理'),bodyTail:document.body.innerText.slice(-1200)});})()
